title: Masking Radar Cognition under Adversarial Surveillance: A Distributional Privacy Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.07428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this article, we propose an online electronic counter-countermeasure (ECCM) framework designed to conceal the strategic decision-making processes of a cognitive radar (CR) operating under adversarial surveillance. We model the CR under two distinct decision paradigms: a static constrained utility-maximizing behavior and a dynamic expected utility-maximizing behavior. The radar's utility function is modeled via a von Mises--Fisher (vMF) distribution, with the distributional parameter constituting the private information to be protected from adversarial inference. We adopt a distribution privacy framework to conceal this private information and provide formal distribution privacy guarantees for cognition masking. In this work, we develop cognition-hiding algorithms for both static constrained utility maximization (WDPCH-SU), and dynamic expected utility maximization (WDPCH-DU). translated_title: 对抗监视下认知雷达的认知遮蔽：一种分布式隐私框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种在线电子反对抗（ECCM）框架，旨在遮蔽运行于对抗性监视环境下的认知雷达（CR）的战略决策过程。我们在两种不同的决策范式下对认知雷达进行建模：静态约束效用最大化行为和动态期望效用最大化行为。雷达的效用函数通过von Mises–Fisher（vMF）分布进行建模，其分布参数构成了需要防止被对手推断的私有信息。我们采用分布式隐私框架来隐藏这一私有信息，并为认知遮蔽提供正式的分布式隐私保证。在这项工作中，我们分别为静态约束效用最大化（WDPCH-SU）和动态期望效用最大化（WDPCH-DU）开发了认知隐藏算法。通过严格的数学分析，我们证明了两者的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于分布式隐私的电子反对抗框架，通过开发两种认知隐藏算法，在对抗监视下遮蔽认知雷达的战略决策过程并提供正式的隐私保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online ECCM framework based on distributional privacy, developing two cognition-hiding algorithms that conceal the strategic decision-making of cognitive radars under adversarial surveillance while providing formal privacy guarantees.
